sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.
sources.pages15: Pages added by the 15-spells project (docs/magic/pages15_batch7.md): canon first, otherwise the mod's own pages in the book's style; each page says which in that document.

spells.name: World Tree Magic: Mistilteinn Seed
spells.note: Offensive: a seed that paralyses and absorbs the target's mana. Mode 0 of the book.

spells.name: World Tree Magic: Magic Tree Descent
spells.note: A Creation spell: roots of a giant tree come down from the sky; at the Magic Knight Entrance Exam he shaped one into a broom.

spells.name: World Tree Magic: Dracaena Formation (the page Root Bind)
spells.note: The wiki's Dracaena Formation is the roots-wrapping spell: he touches the ground and giant roots bind the target. The mod's page is named Root Bind; the match is a design choice.

spells.name: World Tree Magic: Magic Warding Ash
spells.note: Supplementary: a huge ash tree grows and its branches bind the opponent's attacks. NEW page.

spells.name: World Tree Magic: Great Tree Mistilteinn
spells.note: Supplementary: world-tree roots spread over a wide area and absorb the mana of those nearby; the tree can then catch and subdue enemies. NEW page.

spells.name: World Tree Magic: Mistilteinn Blade
spells.note: Listed as supplementary by the wiki; no description was found, so the effect is the mod's reading (a blade of tree wood). NEW page.

spells.name: World Tree Magic: Budding of Yggdrasil
spells.note: Supplementary: the world tree buds and catches attacks in mid-air. His late signature.
